Goblin Lord is the second boss you will encounter in your jorney

"Being a member of the ancient Faction of goblins that once ruled over gold, the Goblin Lord was one of the few survivors after the total annihilation of his clan. Once known for his cowardly nature, he took advantage of the chaos to self-proclain himself as the lord and guardian of gold. His boundless ambition allowed him to seize not only the treasures of his fallen people but also those of the golden depths. After demonstrating his strength and determination to protect gold at all costs, he too will ultimately fail...”
You can summon the Goblin Lord by using an item called the Strange Coin.
Defeating it rewards you with three special items and unlocks the ability to mine gold and use gold tools, armor, and weapons.
Goblin Lord summons 3 Goblins to attack you
Charges an attack that slows players and deals "very high damage" with explosive impact
